subject: trae-agent
title: LakeView: post-hoc LLM pass tags each recorded step with a fixed 8-label SWE taxonomy and dual-granularity summary
one_why: Trajectory analysis as a first-class artifact: cheap extractor+tagger turns raw run JSON into browsable phase-tagged digests - no other corpus subject analyzes its own behavior at step granularity; useful for eval triage and failure classification.

subject: trae-agent
title: Docker 'sandbox' mode routes only 3 tools into the container; MCP and ckg tools still execute on the host
evidence: trae_agent/agent/base_agent.py:68 (docker_tools=["bash","str_replace_based_edit_tool","json_edit_tool"]), trae_agent/tools/docker_tool_executor.py:55-66 (name-based routing, everything else to host executor)
one_why: A user who opts into --docker-image for isolation still gets arbitrary stdio MCP servers (and ckg subprocess work) running unsandboxed on the host - allowlist-by-tool-name silently undercuts the isolation the flag promises.

subject: trae-agent
title: No approval layer exists at all: bash is a default tool executing arbitrary commands on the host
evidence: trae_agent/tools/bash_tool.py:41-59 (create_subprocess_shell on host), trae_agent/agent/trae_agent.py:21-27 (bash in default tool set); grep approv|permission|confirm across trae_agent hits only Docker daemon error text (cli.py:78,398)
one_why: Not even the 6-rung 'tested approval, nothing underneath' exists - the only in-loop gate is max_steps; the contrast case for permission-policy alongside codel's prompt-baked policy, minus any claim of safety.

subject: trae-agent
title: Zero conversation compaction; history grows unbounded inside the client and overflow is met by blind retries (random 3-30s sleeps) then run abort
evidence: trae_agent/utils/llm_clients/openai_compatible_base.py:119-123 (message_history += parsed, no trim), trae_agent/utils/llm_clients/retry_utils.py:38-50, trae_agent/agent/base_agent.py:177-180 (exception -> ERROR abort); only mitigation is 16k-char tool-output truncation (trae_agent/tools/run.py:17-26)
one_why: Long tasks deterministically die at the provider context wall, and the retry decorator wastes minutes re-sending the doomed payload - the floor case for compaction-tiering discussions, worse than codel-4 only in that it doesn't even notice prompt size.

subject: trae-agent
title: Conversation history is owned by the LLM client, not the loop: the loop passes only message deltas
evidence: trae_agent/agent/base_agent.py:166 (messages = await self._run_llm_step(...) returns new messages only) vs openai_compatible_base.py:119-123 (client accumulates); history-loss fix landed as HEAD commit e839e55 'fix(openai): persist tool outputs in message history'
one_why: Explains why compaction is structurally hard here: the loop cannot see, rewrite, or trim the context it is charged with managing; a single history-owner design (loop or session) is the prerequisite for any token-economy work on this codebase.

subject: trae-agent
title: Research harness: a separate sandboxed selector agent adjudicates N candidate patches with grouped majority voting
one_why: Inverts the agent-as-producer frame into agent-as-judge over a patch pool - test-time-compute selection run inside its own tool sandbox; interesting input to evals-in-CI style ranking, though the harness never runs in CI.

subject: trae-agent
title: Tools pyinstaller-frozen on the host, copied into the container at /agent_tools, with host<->container path translation on arguments
evidence: trae_agent/cli.py:101-115 (pyinstaller build of json_edit_tool/edit_tool_cli into dist), trae_agent/agent/docker_manager.py:19,47-66 (CONTAINER_TOOLS_PATH copy on start), trae_agent/tools/docker_tool_executor.py:33-46 (_translate_path)
one_why: SWE-agent's bundle-upload idea specialized for a local Docker sidecar: the agent's tools run natively where commands run, avoiding RPC-per-tool-call, but the tool-name routing list is exactly what finding trae-agent-2 shows can silently leak.
